metadata.summary: Great Britain's outgoing Davis Cup captain Leon Smith hopes "standout candidate" Andy Murray will one day take the role he is vacating after more than 16 years.
metadata.content: Andy Murray: Great Britain's outgoing Davis Cup captain Leon Smith hopes Scot will one day take the role | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Andy Murray: Great Britain's outgoing Davis Cup captain Leon Smith hopes Scot will one day take the role Great Britain's outgoing Davis Cup captain Leon Smith hopes Andy Murray will one day take the role he is vacating; the Scot is not currently interested in taking over due to other commitments; You can watch the ATP Finals in Turin this week on Sky Sports Tennis Friday 20 November 2026 17:42, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Jamie Murray backs his brother Andy or Greg Rusedski to be the next Team GB Davis Cup captain after Leon Smith stepped down from the role after 17 years Great Britain's outgoing Davis Cup captain Leon Smith hopes "standout candidate" Andy Murray will one day take the role he is vacating after more than 16 years. Smith took over from John Lloyd in 2010 following a humiliating loss to Lithuania that left Britain facing relegation to the bottom level of the historic competition. Harnessing the talents and commitment of Murray, who he coached as a junior, Smith led Britain back to the top tier and, only five years later, to a first title since 1936 when they defeated Belgium in 2015.
